hana: Quick sync for AWS/GCP listing prep: legal wants localized EULA, billing needs the pricing JSON, and ops needs an ingress contact for image validation. Can we assign?

kelly (legal): I can own EULA localization. Please confirm canonical EN file and whether Dedicated clause differs for private offers.

omar (billing): I'll produce the pricing JSON. Need final SKUs and trial length. Also confirm whether taxes are marketplace-handled or our side for EU.

hana: EN canonical is eula/redwood-inference-eula-v2.1.md. Dedicated gets an explicit SLA blurb.

kelly (legal): noted. I'll kick off EN->FR/DE today, need locked EN by 4pm PT.

omar (billing): For SKUs use: rdw-trial-eu-small and rdw-dedicated-small. Trial = 14 days. I'll draft JSON and put placeholder Offer ID.

devops-bot: Note: marketplace pipeline will validate manifest in marketplace/pricing/*.json on merge.

hana: Action items: kelly lock EULA and start translations; omar draft pricing JSON; hana to assign ingress contact for image validation. Target submission Mon.

kelly (legal): Ping me once EN is locked.

omar (billing): Drafting now, will post PR link when ready.
